comment: Failures of the behaviour checks (cane_world_sweep behaviour, unlock, fuse) found in the game's shared code and written up for upstream;
like tests/sanitizers/*.supp they are reported as known instead of failing the run. Mac-only problems are never listed here.
An entry matches one failure exactly: a live/reload difference by its whole key ('oid:cid', plus ' 'name'' for a named object), field,
and live and reload values (so its direction too); any other failure by its whole reason. Fuse failures count as level 'Prowling the Grounds'.
Entries for levels that ran but matched nothing are reported as stale (advisory). writeup: the upstream issue (or why there is none yet) and what it is about.
